description: This file implements the Administrator class within the Thunder::RPC namespace, managing IPC channels, proxies, stubs, and interface registration for RPC communication. It includes methods for reference counting, proxy management, validation, and cleanup of IPC resources.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, and IPC channels, handling registration, reference counting, validation, and cleanup of IPC resources.

methods.name: ~Administrator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up proxies and stubs.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for an interface on a given IPC channel.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for an interface and releases it if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Completes a proxy call, signaling invocation completion.

methods.name: UnregisterUnknownProxy
methods.description: Removes a proxy from internal management structures.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Dispatches an invoke message to the appropriate stub handler based on interface ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates if an implementation instance is associated with a given channel and interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy for a given implementation and interface on a channel.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given implementation and interface.

methods.name: RegisterUnknown
methods.description: Registers a new interface implementation with a channel.

methods.name: UnregisterUnknown
methods.description: Unregisters an interface implementation from a channel.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a raw implementation pointer to a Core::IUnknown* based on stub mapping.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Removes all proxies and references associated with a channel, reporting dangling proxies.
